build_FCOS_detector: build a FCOS center-based object detector with a backbone, head, and focal loss parameters
create_FCOSHead_module: create a FCOSHead module with centerness prediction on top of RetinaNetHead for feature maps
run_FCOS_forward_training: run FCOS forward training to compute classification, box regression, and centerness losses
test_FCOS_match_anchors: test the FCOS match_anchors method to match anchor points with ground truth boxes using center sampling
review_FCOS_inference: review the FCOS forward_inference method that applies NMS and returns top detections per image
